journey.title: Diagnose a route
journey.purpose: Move from a visible route problem to a classified cause and a safe next action.

steps.intent: Select a route or finding that needs attention.
Compare local listener, tunnel ingress, external probe, and access policy signals.
See which diagnostic source failed and retry without losing the last known evidence.
Understand whether automatic recovery is active, backing off, or blocked.
Open the specific port or governance remediation when the route contract is the cause.
